description: Roman source inventory before u-head normalization. The current allocation and exact cap segment fingerprints identify visible turned-h/turned-m heads; donor dependency records alone overcount because many heads are replaced or clipped.

matcher.method: Three consecutive native line segments (vertical leading edge, rising top wedge, horizontal top), identified by translation-invariant endpoint deltas in the authoritative UFO contours and restricted to U+0265 or U+026F construction references.
matcher.positionMeaning: Start of the vertical leading edge in source font units.
exclusions: Standalone U+F2A03 STEM and U+F2A06 DESCENDER share the Regular fingerprint but use the contextual U+0131 donor.
Italic u and turned-h heads already agree in design; no Italic heads are targeted.
